dimensions.evidence_span: Subject opens with a falsifiable position stated before any evidence: "GitHub가 npm 공급망을 지키겠다며 내놓은 조치와, 실제로 뚫린 사고는 서로 다른 이야기가 아니다. 같은 문 이야기다." Reference (G-01) opens the same way: "추론 가격이 내려가도 SaaS gross margin은 회복되지 않는다." Both name a position a reader could disagree with in the first two sentences, before any citation appears.
dimensions.rationale: Neither piece opens by describing a topic; both stake a checkable claim immediately.

dimensions.evidence_span: G-01 constructs a positive causal mechanism none of its sources states on its own: "seat 기반 과금이 완충 장치가 아니라 증폭 장치로 작동한다... 단가 30% 하락이 소비량 50% 증가와 만나면 COGS는 늘어난다." The subject's synthesis is an absence-observation rather than a constructed mechanism: "이 사고를 분석한 세 개의 독립된 리포트... 중 어느 것도 피해 환경이 npm v12 이상을 쓰고 있었는지... 다루지 않는다." — this connects two real, independently-checked facts (the mitigation's target vector and the incident reports' silence about it) but the connective move is naming a gap, not deriving a new mechanism the way G-01's seat-billing amplifier is derived.
dimensions.rationale: Both syntheses go beyond restating a source, but G-01's is a stronger synthetic move (a derived causal mechanism) than the subject's (an observed absence across three sources).

dimensions.evidence_span: Both read as composed Korean rather than translated discourse — subject: "이것은 방어가 실패했다는 증거가 아니다. 방어가 실제로 작동했는지조차 아직 아무도 확인하지 않았다는 증거다." uses the same natural clause-final reasoning as G-01's "단가가 내려간 것은 list price이고, 마진을 결정하는 것은 seat당 실제 소비량이기 때문이다." Both retain English technical terms only where domain-native (subject: trusted publishing, preinstall, opt-in, CI 러너; G-01: gross margin, list price, COGS) per editorial/voice.md §1, rather than translating them awkwardly or leaving unnecessary English noun strings elsewhere.
dimensions.rationale: No stilted phrasing or unglossed machine-translation tell found in either text; English-term retention follows the same domain-native pattern in both.

dimensions.evidence_span: The subject uses one "A가 아니라 B다" contrast: "여기서 눈에 띄는 것은 침해 자체가 아니라 침묵이다... 이것은 방어가 실패했다는 증거가 아니다. 방어가 실제로 작동했는지조차 아직 아무도 확인하지 않았다는 증거다." — this appears once, at the close, not repeated across successive paragraphs, so it does not cross editorial/voice.md §3's threshold ("repeated constructions... across successive paragraphs make the writer visible"). G-01 similarly uses one contrast move mid-argument ("가격이 내려간 것은... 마진을 결정하는 것은...") without repeating it.
dimensions.rationale: A single instance of a recognizable contrast move is a legitimate rhetorical choice in both texts, not a quota-driven signature; neither shows repetition.
